name: radiosonde-drift
description: Прогноз смещения радиозонда: бэкенд на Fastify + фронтенд на React

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @rs/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rs/shared && npm run build -w @rs/server && npm run build -w @rs/web
scripts.user: npm run build -w @rs/shared && npm run user -w @rs/server --
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @rs/shared && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
